ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2023 entering class (ADM2023) and fall 2023 enrollment (EF2023A)

navigator.title: College Navigator profile (fall 2024 admissions summary, 2024-25 costs)

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class); no Common Data Set was found on Kean's Institutional Research pages, so GPA, residency and international applicant splits are not available. College Navigator (fall 2024): 13,936 applicants, 76% admitted, 19% of admits enrolled. SAT/ACT percentiles are omitted because only about 1% of enrolled first-years submitted SAT scores (10 students in fall 2023). Undergraduate enrollment 11,234 and 682 nonresident-alien undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2023 (full-time plus part-time). Kean merged with New Jersey City University on July 1, 2026; these figures predate the merger.
